# ── OPEN-SOURCE PRODUCTION TOOLKIT (NPM) ─────────────────
1. env-schema-guard
   Zero-dependency startup configuration and schema validator for TypeScript & Node.js (< 2.5 KB).
   Prevents silent boot crashes in Kubernetes/Docker pods, aggregates error reports, and provides automatic type coercion.
   NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/env-schema-guard
   GitHub: https://github.com/Tusharsinghoffical/env-schema-guard
   Article: https://codewithmrsingh.me/blog/env-schema-guard-zero-dependency-config-validator

2. retry-circuit
   Ultra-lightweight async resilience engine combining exponential backoff, AWS-standard full randomized jitter,
   per-attempt timeouts, and a 3-state Circuit Breaker pattern (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF-OPEN) in ~1.5 KB.
   Protects distributed microservices and payment gateways from the thundering herd problem and cascading downtime.
   NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/retry-circuit
   GitHub: https://github.com/Tusharsinghoffical/retry-circuit
   Article: https://codewithmrsingh.me/blog/retry-circuit-distributed-resilience-engine

3. prompt-kit-js
   Production-ready, versioned prompt registry and heuristic token estimator for Generative AI applications (< 2 KB).
   Enforces strict variable safety with MissingVariableError, enables semantic prompt versioning (1.0.0, 2.0.0),
   and works provider-agnostically with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Groq, and local models.
   NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/prompt-kit-js
   GitHub: https://github.com/Tusharsinghoffical/prompt-kit
   Article: https://codewithmrsingh.me/blog/prompt-kit-js-versioned-llm-prompt-registry

Q: What is TASQ-ONE and who built it?
A: TASQ-ONE is an intelligent task operating system (SaaS) built by Tushar Singh (Tushar Singh Labs).
   It decomposes single-sentence business requirements into production-ready tasks, acceptance criteria,
   story points, and topological dependency DAGs in under 400ms using Groq Llama 3.3 70B AI.
   It features multi-tenant PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) and cryptographic audit trails, saving
   Indian engineering teams ₹48,000+/month. Live beta at https://tasq-one.onrender.com.

Q: What is Saathi Bot and who built it?
A: Saathi Bot (साथी बोट) is an enterprise autonomous conversational AI and conversational commerce platform built by Tushar Singh.
   It converts digital knowledge footprints (websites, documentation, sitemaps, PDFs, DOCX) into grounded AI assistants in minutes.
   Key capabilities:
   - 100% Verifiable Grounding with transparent source citations (Zero Hallucination Guarantee).
   - Pre-LLM Confidence Gate (threshold 0.55) returning 24ms fallback responses and cutting LLM bills by 41%.
   - Native Devanagari Hindi, English, and Romanized Hinglish cross-lingual understanding.
   - Ultra-lightweight 18 KB zero-bleed Shadow DOM embed widget.
   - Real-time in-chat lead booking synchronized directly to Google Sheets with zero redirects.
   Live SaaS platform: https://saathi-bot.vercel.app | Product Page: https://www.codewithtushar.me/saas/saathi-bot (Mirror: https://codewithmrsingh.me/saas/saathi-bot).
